title: Implement GET /api/prospects/[slug] and PATCH /api/prospects/[slug] routes
description: Create the routes for reading and updating a single prospect by slug. PATCH supports partial updates for the page_data and business fields (for the editor).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/prospects/[slug] returns full prospect with page_data parsed from JSON
PATCH /api/prospects/[slug] accepts partial updates { page_data?, business_name?, industry?, ... }

steps.details: Export GET and PATCH handlers. GET: call `getProspectBySlug(slug)`. If null, 404. Otherwise return with page_data JSON parsed.

Parse request JSON body. Fields allowed: business_name, industry, location, phone, email, notes, page_data (object, will be JSON.stringify'd). Call `updateProspect(slug, fields)` from repository. Return updated prospect.
GET a known slug. PATCH its notes field. GET again and verify notes updated. Test GET with invalid slug returns 404.
